svg.text: THE 74-ENTRY COMMAND TABLE AT 0000:4F94: SCRIPT BYTE 80H + N
Labels are short names of this chapter (the source names the handlers by address only). Number: how often the byte starts a command in
the shipped adlib.dat and sound.dat; a dashed cell is a handler no shipped sound uses. Grey 'end' cells share the end-of-script handler (4311);
so do the bytes F1h to FFh, while CAh to F0h jump through whatever follows the table. A byte below 80h is a note, not a command.
